name: Aoaz
description: The geography of Aoaz for the drawn-map import (ADR 0067): converted by tools/content/geography/convert_for_import.mjs from the repaired model aoaz.repaired.json, with the bays, gulfs and strait crossings of coast_features.json (owner decision K46). Names follow the owner decisions and the realm roster; renamed drawn labels are listed in aoaz.names.json.

seas.name: The Frozen Sea
seas.note: Drawn on the Cold Lands sheet; the map shows only its southern arm, the great bay that cuts into the Cold Lands' north-east coast.

seas.name: Pandar
seas.note: Drawn 'Pandar - The Frozen Seas': the ice-choked bay on the Cold Lands' west coast below Tinton.

seas.name: Norrai Sea
seas.note: Drawn twice (Cold Lands and West-Earth sheets): the cold ocean between the Cold Lands, the West Lands and Triton's Islands.

seas.name: Windy Seas
seas.note: Drawn on the Tornado Islands sheet: the gale-swept water north of the Triton arcs.

seas.name: Pupor Sea
seas.note: Vault: Triton's Islands arc around the Pupor Ocean. Drawn as 'Aufoer Ocean' (uncertain reading); the vault spelling wins.

seas.name: Seas of Lemo
seas.note: Drawn east of Raerby.

seas.name: Amarelo Seas
seas.note: Drawn south of Raerby.

seas.name: Santon Sea
seas.note: Drawn off Santon, the south-west arc of Triton's Islands.

seas.name: Kradlon Sea
seas.note: Drawn south of Kradlon: the sea in the bay between Kradlon and Corogon and the ocean south of it.

seas.name: The Blue Sea
seas.note: Drawn east of the West Lands: the sea that lies between the West Lands' east coast and the central sea.

seas.name: Suddmarg
seas.note: Drawn south of the Yeti Shallows and Poloto.

seas.name: Siroler Seas
seas.note: Drawn off the Cold Lands' east coast (Wonderland, Vaestia).

seas.name: Crown Sea
seas.note: Proposed name for the central sea (drawn 'Rush Ocean', superseded). The wide sea between the West Lands and the Middle Lands.

seas.name: Londolo
seas.note: Drawn 'Londolo - The Great Sea of the Leviathan': the northern ocean west of Lerenwaith.

seas.name: Onp
seas.note: Drawn south of Lerenwaith, around Philippenia and Gil'dul.

seas.name: Leren Sea
seas.note: Drawn between the North Lands and the Middle Lands (two labels). The sea of the Narrow Strait.

seas.name: Sea of Monsters
seas.note: Drawn off the Middle Lands' north-west coast.

seas.name: Nesmael
seas.note: Drawn off the Middle Lands' south-west coast (Safeton).

seas.name: Rim Sea
seas.note: Drawn between R'en and the Bloody Forest coast; with R'en Ocean it is the eastern end of the Narrow Strait.

seas.name: Kusmeel
seas.note: Vault: the Ocean of Zol with its black islands. Drawn 'Ocean of Edvoid' (superseded).

seas.name: Gorlab Sea
seas.note: Drawn off Andos Enda and Filion at the north end of the rift (reading uncertain: Gorlab or Cololab).

seas.name: The Rift Sea
seas.note: Drawn 'The Magical Ocean': the long rift sea between the Magical Lands and the East Lands. The East Lands sheet calls its east shore the Khadon Ocean.

seas.name: The Reeto Sea
seas.note: Drawn off the Mushroom Forest; the southern reach of the rift (the East sheet's 'Reeto Seas').

seas.name: Dulundur Sea
seas.note: Drawn beside Dulundur, north of Dondor.

seas.name: Sea of Darkness
seas.note: Vault: a Dark Lands name. Placed as the sheltered inner sea between the Dondor arm and the Goldoroth arm; its drawn grey island is a separate land. Whether it is an inland sea is an owner question.

seas.name: Sea of Dobudo
seas.note: Drawn at the east mouth of the Dark Lands' inner channel.

seas.name: Gaelmael
seas.note: Drawn east of the Dark Lands: the southern strait between the Dark Lands and the Middle Lands.

seas.name: The Goldoroth Wides
seas.note: Drawn off Goldoroth's south-east shore.

seas.name: Sea of Dolon
seas.note: Drawn south of the Goldoroth Islands (reading uncertain).

seas.name: Belonton Water
seas.note: Proposed: the water off Belonton and the Goldoroth Islands, open to the Crown Ocean.

seas.name: Vehmial
seas.note: Drawn west of the Ember Lands.

seas.name: Veshir
seas.note: Drawn north of Demon and Dolon.

seas.name: Sea of Mernon
seas.note: Drawn west of Mirolon (reading Mernon or Nanor).

seas.name: Veleeda
seas.note: Drawn 'Veleeda, the Dead's Sea': the water between Mirolon's south coast and the Ember Lands' north-east.

seas.name: Sea of Nazerch
seas.note: Drawn off the Nezer and Abyss coast.

seas.name: Sea of Lava
seas.note: Drawn off the Nether: the glowing southern sea.

seas.name: Naam-Maqr
seas.note: Drawn south-west of the East Lands' southern desert.

seas.name: The Long Sea
seas.note: Drawn through the Islands of the South.

seas.name: Seas of Lusain
seas.note: Drawn north-east of the Islands of the South.

seas.name: Sharp Seas
seas.note: Drawn south-east of the Islands of the South.

seas.name: The Ihuy Sea
seas.note: Drawn among the Ihuy islands (placement proposed).

seas.name: Sala Aila
seas.note: Drawn north of the Lands of the Sun.

seas.name: Sea of Gods
seas.note: Established. The warm pale sea on the north-east shore of the Lands of the Sun, below the Gala isles (placement proposed).

seas.name: Zavrekir
seas.note: Vault: fierce storms at sea made the Ember Lands hard for First Age explorers. Proposed permanent storm belt around the islands (attrition and port capacity modifier, see the magic spec).

lands.name: The Nether
lands.note: The Nether: the volcanic land south of the Ember Lands island and the seat of the King of Demons (vault: the Nether lies in the south of the Ember Lands). Drawn at the foot of the Ember Lands sheet and carried south past the sheet edge; sized by the repair for at least three states of three provinces. Reached over the Nether Sound from the Ember Lands island, over the Ember Narrows from the South Lands, and inland through the Cinder Gate across the Nether Mountains.

regions.name: The Nether
regions.note: Vault: the Nether lies in the south of the Ember Lands (region_ember_lands) and is the seat of the King of Demons. A region of its own within region_ember_lands, below it, so that the import gives it its own states; the repair adds it.

ranges.name: Icy Mountains
ranges.note: West-coast range above Tinton; ice-sheathed, peaks near Tinton.

ranges.name: Yeldenne Heights
ranges.note: Proposed ring of crags on the west side of Mp'E: Castle of Yeldenne stands in a high valley between this range and the Isengar Mountains.

ranges.name: Isengar Mountains
ranges.note: Drawn beside Isengard and Mp'E; the east wall of the Yeldenne valley.

ranges.name: Coldor Mountains
ranges.note: Drawn along the south coast of the Cold Lands facing the Yeti Lands across a narrow channel.

ranges.name: Cold Mountains
ranges.note: The Naepu and Fearno ridges, then the arc along the Cold Lands east coast; the highest range of the north.

ranges.name: Neridor Mountains
ranges.note: The mountain rampart of the neck between the Cold Lands and the West Lands (drawn Meridor/Neridor, Ollondo; reading uncertain).

ranges.name: Hendair Hills
ranges.note: Lone dark massif in the Coldor plain.

ranges.name: Olsuaon Massif
ranges.note: Dark massif in the north-west plain.

ranges.name: Nivaros Heights
ranges.note: Proposed ice-giant uplands in the far north-west.

ranges.name: Herlitz Mountains
ranges.note: The west spine of the Kradlon peninsula (drawn Herlitz and Dusty Mountains run into one range).

ranges.name: Dusty Mountains
ranges.note: South-western continuation of the Herlitz range; dry, bare.

ranges.name: Fog and Eye Mountains
ranges.note: East-west cross range south of Girdon that divides the Girdon plain from Buldor.

ranges.name: Bolpor and Boldor Mountains
ranges.note: The east flank of the Kulolo valley; falls to the Blue Sea.

ranges.name: Erg Mountains
ranges.note: Dark spur at the tip of the western finger of Gunwaith.

ranges.name: Black Hills
ranges.note: Dark headland at the south-west tip of Kradlon.

ranges.name: Corogon Highlands
ranges.note: The olive-brown uplands of the Corogon peninsula.

ranges.name: Adel Mountains
ranges.note: Ridge along the Adel arc.

ranges.name: Benan Mountains
ranges.note: Peaks of Benan, the inner island of the western arc.

ranges.name: Raerby and Hapos Mountains
ranges.note: Spine of Raerby, the eastern arc.

ranges.name: Loron Mountains
ranges.note: North-western highland of Lerendor; Loso and Loron.

ranges.name: Wely and Fair Mountains
ranges.note: Ring of high ground that encloses the Evian Sea.

ranges.name: Solondor Mountains
ranges.note: Snow-capped southern ridge above the Leren Ocean.

ranges.name: Etonia and Renann Mountains
ranges.note: Ridge between Eekedor and R'en.

ranges.name: The Darkness
ranges.note: Black ridge across the middle of the Dark Lands (drawn The Darkness, Hills of Dark, Mountains of Dark).

ranges.name: Goldoroth Mountains
ranges.note: Black mountains of Goldoroth with the Dark Gate at their foot.

ranges.name: Great Wall of Aenor
ranges.note: Established: runs from the Organ Mountains past Lunhrim and around Kingson and separates the Middle Lands from the Magical Lands. Model: one continuous massif of elevation 5 (core about 60 pixels wide, 150 to 250 pixels with its flanking ranges and foothills; no gaps except the four named gates), with the man-made wall on its east crest. It is the mountain barrier the owner asked for; the Pale March of Elzon's Order is its proposed origin.

ranges.name: Organ Mountains
ranges.note: North end of the Great Wall (owner description): fluted basalt columns that meet the sea at the Organ cape on the Narrow Strait.

ranges.name: Lunhrim
ranges.note: The great fortress massif of the wall, between the Organ Mountains and Kingson (owner description; drawn Kunhrim, reading uncertain). Peak at (0.661,0.515).

ranges.name: Kingson Wall
ranges.note: East side of the Kingson ring: the westernmost ridge of the Magic Mountains, which stand along the whole Magical Lands border.

ranges.name: Gigantic Mountains
ranges.note: West side of the Kingson ring (drawn Gigantic Mountains, a long diagonal belt); separates Kingson from Hunhun and the Great Lake plain.

ranges.name: Crown Mountains
ranges.note: South side of the Kingson ring: drawn Rush Mountains (superseded name; proposed player-facing name Crown Mountains, owner question 10).

ranges.name: Giant Mountains
ranges.note: South section of the Great Wall (drawn Giant Mountains and Cursed Mountains): a long wild ridge down to the south coast. No wall masonry; the elves and dragons guard it.

ranges.name: Dragon Mountain
ranges.note: The highest massif of the Wall belt and home of the dragons; stands at the south-east corner of the Kingson ring just east of the wall line, so that it belongs to the Magical Lands side. Not a country.

ranges.name: Hiloff Rim
ranges.note: Coastal ridge on the west shore from Selen to Hiloron (the brown rim drawn as the Wall of Rush on the north-west coast; the vault puts the Great Wall in the east, so this is only a coastal ridge).

ranges.name: Konori Heights
ranges.note: Drawn Rush Mountains under the Bloody Forest: foothill ridge on the Konori side of the wall.

ranges.name: Grano Mountains
ranges.note: Grey hills between Hiloron and the Great Lake.

ranges.name: Deodolor Hills
ranges.note: Brown ridge north of the Stone Forest.

ranges.name: The Grey Hills
ranges.note: Brown hills of the south coast above Herez.

ranges.name: Tinta Hills
ranges.note: Brown hills on the east end of the isle.

ranges.name: Magic Mountains
ranges.note: Snow-capped parallel ridges that stand east of the wall, drawn as the white ridges of the Magic Mountains.

ranges.name: Tirikraniel
ranges.note: Middle snow ridge of the Magic Mountains.

ranges.name: Lozo Heights
ranges.note: Southern ridge of the Magic Mountains beside Lake Lozo.

ranges.name: Herrodon Mountains
ranges.note: The massive northern rim of the Magical Lands: the brown highland of Herrodon and Andos Enda against the Kusmeel.

ranges.name: Lustras Hills
ranges.note: Hills south of Herrodon Mountains.

ranges.name: Nolorim Heights
ranges.note: Proposed high crags of Nolorim: the high passes of the south frontier lie here (owner question 8: they may face the eastern approach or the road from the Ember Lands; the model faces them south and east).

ranges.name: Cursed Mountains
ranges.note: Narrow dark ridge at the south end of the Kingson ring.

ranges.name: The Barren Crown
ranges.note: Proposed low ridge of black rock across the Mistake. Unnamed in the vault.

ranges.name: Mirolon Mountains
ranges.note: East-west ridge across the Mirolon peninsula.

ranges.name: Demonic Mountains
ranges.note: Burning ridge on the west of the Ember Lands island.

ranges.name: Nether Mountains

ranges.name: Nan Mountains

ranges.name: Woqood Alps

ranges.name: Hardtmuth Mountains

ranges.name: Hellfire Range

ranges.name: Pego Mountains

ranges.name: Drak Mountains
ranges.note: Brown volcanic ridge of Drak at the east edge.

ranges.name: Ernois Mountains
ranges.note: Proposed coral-red highland east of the Hot Lake (drawn Ernois).

ranges.name: Reeto Heights
ranges.note: Proposed black-rock mountains on the rift coast above the southern lobe (drawn as the black block west of Alerhia).

ranges.name: Noris Rise

ranges.name: Wide Mountains

ranges.name: Sun Mountains

ranges.name: Sukro Mountains

passes.name: The Neck Road

passes.name: Neridor Gap
passes.note: The gap in the Neridor Mountains where the Fandan River and the Neck Road pass together.

passes.name: The Grey Ford
passes.note: Proposed ford on the Grey River between Gunwaith (north) and Girdon (south): the Truce of the Grey Ford was signed here.

passes.name: Fog Gap

passes.name: Dark Gate

passes.name: Path of Dark

passes.name: Great River Gorge
passes.note: The gorge of The Great River through the Gigantic Mountains, the west side of the Kingson ring: the river's own course through a 180-pixel opening in the range, the only low road between the Kingson Vale and the Great Lake plain.

passes.name: Organ Coast Road
passes.note: A coastal road under the cliffs of the Organ cape; narrow, held by the Bloody Forest side.

passes.name: The South Pass
passes.note: Gate of the southern wall at the Herez road, between the Giant Mountains and the Cursed Lands.

passes.name: Lunhrim Notch

passes.name: Nolorim West Pass

passes.name: Nolorim East Pass
passes.note: Nolorim's high pass above the Lake of Mirolon.

passes.name: The Boundary Groves
passes.note: Groves on the Andos Water where Herrodon and Andos Enda meet (site spec).

passes.name: Mirolon Passes
passes.note: Proposed passes where the Mirolon Mountains close the land neck from the Zilin side; the vault speaks of Mirolon's northern passes the gate Volgan must take. The sea lies between Mirolon and the Ember Lands.

passes.name: Noris Gap
passes.note: Gap in the Noris Rise on the Salt Road.

passes.name: Hardtmuth Pass

passes.name: Melty Pass

passes.name: Dondor Pass

passes.name: Isengar Pass

passes.name: The Cinder Gate

volcanoes.name: Goldoroth Volcano

volcanoes.name: Demonic Fire

volcanoes.name: Mount Nether

volcanoes.name: Mount Ergo

rivers.name: Fandan River
rivers.note: Proposed. The one great river of the Cold Lands: from Yeldenne Heights through the Neridor gap to the Cold Ocean at Poloto. Frozen four months a year; the natural line between Coldor (west) and Isengard (north-east).

rivers.name: Naepu River
rivers.note: Proposed. Runs from the Naepu ridge north-east to the Siroler coast.

rivers.name: Orewell Water
rivers.note: Proposed. North-flowing stream of the Orewell lowland to the northern edge.

rivers.name: Kulolo River
rivers.note: Drawn blue river between the Bolpor and Boldor ranges; ends in the Ilurdor lagoon. The natural line between Girdon and Saopon.

rivers.name: Grey River
rivers.note: Proposed. The border river of Gunwaith and Girdon; the Grey Ford (Truce of the Grey Ford) crosses it where the Neck Road meets the Kulolo road.

rivers.name: Ronbo Water
rivers.note: Proposed stream through the Ronbo Grasslands to the Kradlon Ocean.

rivers.name: Leren River
rivers.note: Proposed river that drains the Evian lake to the Leren Ocean at Sonargur.

rivers.name: The Giant River
rivers.note: Drawn blue river through the Giant Forest; runs along the south foot of the Darkness ridge into the inner sea.

rivers.name: River Aenar
rivers.note: Proposed. The main river of the Vale: leaves the Lunhrim foothills, crosses Konori and the Vale and enters the Great Lake under the Parim bluff. The name follows Aenor and does not decide the open question of whether Aenor is named for Aen.

rivers.name: The Great River
rivers.note: Drawn The Great River (reading uncertain): drains the Kingson Vale through the gorge in the Gigantic Mountains into the Great Lake. Kingson's lifeline and the only low pass through the ring.

rivers.name: River Selenar
rivers.note: Proposed. Rises under the Crown Mountains and crosses the Selen glades to the Sea of Monsters; the natural line between Selen (north) and the Vale (south).

rivers.name: River Safen

rivers.name: River Hilorn
rivers.note: Proposed short river from the Hiloron woods to the Crown Ocean.

rivers.name: Konorar
rivers.note: Proposed. North-flowing stream from Konori to the Narrow Strait beside the Bloody Forest.

rivers.name: Elwen River
rivers.note: Proposed. The great river of the Magical Forest: from the Magic Mountains east through the forest to the rift coast.

rivers.name: Andos Water

rivers.name: Lozo Water
rivers.note: Proposed outflow of Lake Lozo toward the Zilin Hills and the Mirolon marsh.

rivers.name: Teste Brook

rivers.name: Furvi Run
rivers.note: Proposed dark stream to the southern coast at Furviatlon.

rivers.name: Shaar-Sheek

rivers.name: Fosoco River
rivers.note: Proposed. West-bank feeder of the Hot Lake.

rivers.name: The Meltwater

rivers.name: River Tich

rivers.name: Adel Burn

rivers.name: Kerhil Water

rivers.name: R'en Water

rivers.name: Dondor Water

rivers.name: Sunwater

rivers.name: River Mirolon

lakes.name: Lake of Mirolon
